content:
The image shows a single mango leaf that is almost entirely brown/necrotic, shriveled, and desiccated. The leaf has curled and dried out completely, with dark brown to black coloration throughout. There is no white powdery coating (rules out Powdery_Mildew), no black sooty surface deposit (rules out Sooty_Mould), and no localized anthracnose lesions with defined margins. Instead, the entire shoot tip/leaf has died back — this is classic progressive tip/shoot death consistent with Die_Back disease, where the tissue dies from the tip inward, leaving a completely necrotic, shriveled leaf.
